provenance.license: public domain (sigrok-dumps README: 'Unless noted otherwise, all dump files are hereby released into the public domain by their authors')
provenance.setup: a DS3231 module (with an EEPROM at 0x50, played back as captured) in 24-hour mode, a Geeetech FX2 board at 4 MHz on SCL and SDA (README.sigrok)

cases.name: ds3231_ex1

history.why: the control register as set before the capture (1Fh: alarm interrupts enabled; power-on is 1Ch)
the status register as left before the capture (08h: OSF cleared earlier)

cases.doc: read and write the control and status registers, set both alarms, read the time (the clock set before the capture: start) and the temperature

cases.name: ds3231_ex2

history.why: the status register with A2F set by the alarm armed before the capture (0Ah)

cases.doc: after alarm 2: read and clear the status register's flag, read the time and the temperature
